comparison.objective: Seat a long blind headrail in two brackets and close their gates; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part placement and retainer closure versus concentric screw/nut tool control.
comparison.success_condition: Rail home in both brackets with both gates shut versus 90° stop retained over three actuations.
comparison.reason: Long-part installation and gate closure are physically different from torque-preserved adjustment.
